title: How to make a KPI dashboard in Excel in 3 steps (with free templates)
summary: Learn how to create a KPI dashboard in Excel or use one of our free dashboard templates for efficient business analytics and timely decision-making.
body_markdown: **A note on using spreadsheets:** Spreadsheets are fine when you're small. But once you hit about 100 customers, it starts getting messy. Even[upgrading to a database](https://zapier.com/blog/database-vs-spreadsheet/) can make a huge difference: you'll have better logs of what changed and when, and it offers more options for segmentation.
